<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Click the left square (around col 11)

print(f"Gameplay changed: {last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
gray_count = len([n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'w'])
print(f"Gray (w) objects now: {gray_count}")

# Check which bars changed
before = last_transition.before_frame.segmentation
before_w = [n for n in before['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'w']
after_w = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'w']

before_boundaries = [str((n['boundary'][0], n['boundary'][-1])) for n in before_w]
after_boundaries = [str((n['boundary'][0], n['boundary'][-1])) for n in after_w]

removed = set(before_boundaries) - set(after_boundaries)
added = set(after_boundaries) - set(before_boundaries)
print(f"Removed {len(removed)} bars, Added {len(added)} bars")
for r in sorted(removed):
    print(f"  Removed: {r}")
for a in sorted(added):
    print(f"  Added: {a}")

# Check bottom squares
print("\nBottom squares:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    min_row = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
    if min_row >= 53 and n['color'] in ('b', 'g', 'B'):
        print(f"  color={n['color']}, boundary={n['boundary']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
